model_variant.name: Corrected model: reversion applied between seasons

pre_registered_parameters.rating_alpha_note: Share of the residual applied to the team's offensive and defensive rating after each game.
pre_registered_parameters.mean_reversion_note: Share of a team's rating reverted toward the league mean after each game.
pre_registered_parameters.home_field_advantage_note: Fixed project assumption, applied only when the designated home team hosted the game. Neutral-site games (recorded in the location field) get no home-field advantage.
pre_registered_parameters.league_mean_note: Prior for the league mean points per team per game, used with an expanding window of prior results.
pre_registered_parameters.sigma_note: Prior for the residual standard deviation used to convert a point differential into a win probability.
pre_registered_parameters.min_games_note: No minimum; the model may forecast from the first game of the archive, but such forecasts are flagged as cold-start.

note: Every row is a forecast made strictly before the game it describes.
